forecasts.question: Will the US or Israel conduct a publicly confirmed airstrike specifically targeting the Fordow fuel enrichment plant or the Arak/Pickaxe Mountain facility before EOD 2026-07-22?
forecasts.delta_reason: New forecast: Trump explicitly threatened a strike on 'Pickaxe Mountain' (Arak IR-40 facility) 2026-07-14; US in 8th+ consecutive night of strikes on Iran as of 2026-07-19; no Fordow/Arak strike confirmed yet in current sequence.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if CENTCOM or IDF officially confirm a new airstrike specifically targeting the Fordow fuel enrichment plant (near Qom) or the Arak IR-40 heavy-water facility/'Pickaxe Mountain' between 2026-07-19 and EOD 2026-07-22. Prior Midnight Hammer strikes on Fordow do not count.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: CENTCOM official press release naming Fordow or Arak as struck target, OR Reuters/AP/AFP reporting with specific facility name; IDF statement + one TIER1 also qualifies.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Strikes on other Iranian nuclear-adjacent or military sites (Isfahan, Bushehr, IRGC bases, air defense nodes, energy infrastructure) without explicit Fordow/Arak confirmation = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. Iranian state media claims without CENTCOM/IDF or TIER1 corroboration = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

Trump publicly declares Fordow/Pickaxe Mountain strike in named press conference

forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if an official spokesperson or foreign minister of Oman, Qatar, or Pakistan publicly confirms (via press release, press conference, or official statement carried by TIER1) that it has transmitted a ceasefire proposal or 'pause in hostilities' request from the US government or Iranian government to the other side, between 2026-07-19 and EOD 2026-08-01. Mediator meetings on unrelated bilateral matters without explicit ceasefire-facilitation language = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. General diplomatic statements about 'wanting peace' without specific ceasefire-proposal relay = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

forecasts.question: Will the Strait of Hormuz record a 7-day average of ≥20 commercial vessel transits per day before EOD 2026-09-14?
forecasts.delta_reason: New forecast: Hormuz at approximately 10 transits/day (11% of 88/day baseline) per PortWatch 2026-07-12; ceasefire collapsed 2026-07-08; threshold set at 20/day (vs prior F4's 50/day) to reflect structurally lower post-war baseline.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if IMF PortWatch records ≥20 commercial vessel transits per day averaged over any consecutive 7-day window between 2026-07-19 and EOD 2026-09-14. Naval vessels without confirmed commercial cargo excluded. The 20/day threshold represents approximately 23% of the pre-crisis 88/day baseline.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: IMF PortWatch 7-day moving average series + one TIER1 or OSINT shipping report (Bloomberg/Reuters/Lloyd's List/Straits.live). Windward Daily Intelligence or UANI Iran Shipping Update also qualifies as OSINT corroboration.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Single-day spikes ≥20 without a consecutive 7-day window average ≥20 = NO. Vessels transiting in 'dark mode' without independent confirmation count as zero. If PortWatch data contains a gap or revision of >5 days, the most recent confirmed pre-gap weekly average takes precedence.

indicators.expected_effect: Primary prerequisite; transit volume below 20/day without minimum pause in anti-ship operations

forecasts.question: Will Israeli national elections proceed on the currently scheduled date of 2026-10-27 without postponement or cancellation?
forecasts.delta_reason: New forecast: Knesset formally dissolved 2026-07-17 with 62-0 vote; Israeli Central Elections Committee confirmed 2026-10-27; non-trivial risk of postponement given ongoing Iran war escalation and direct Iranian strike capability against Israeli territory.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if polls open in Israel on 2026-10-27 and ballots are cast in national Knesset elections on that date. YES even if results are subsequently disputed. NO if the Central Elections Committee formally postpones or cancels the election to a different date before EOD 2026-10-27.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Israeli Central Elections Committee official statement + Reuters/AP or Times of Israel confirming polls opened on 2026-10-27. Haaretz or Jerusalem Post election-day liveblog also qualifies.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: If elections held in partial format but Central Elections Committee has not declared postponement: YES. If elections postponed by ≤7 days under emergency security provisions: AMBIGUOUS. Any formal postponement >7 days from Oct 27 = NO.

Digital MOU signing 2026-06-14 = written/distance exchange per ambiguity rule, not convened session. Pathway 2 (official rescission of June 1 suspension) not triggered; Ghalibaf MOU signature is a diplomatic act on a distinct track, not a formal rescission of the Oman-channel suspension. Judge ruling: RESOLVED-NO.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a formally convened negotiating session between named US and Iranian principals/envoys occurs before EOD 2026-06-16, OR if Iran issues an official statement formally rescinding the 2026-06-01 suspension of Oman-channel talks before EOD 2026-06-16.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Two independent TIER1 OR one TIER1 + official Iranian state-media (IRNA or Tasnim; PressTV requires secondary TIER1 confirmation); State Dept or Iran MFA statement also resolves.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Trump-only assertions without Iranian/mediator confirmation = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. Written-message exchanges or digital signings that are not a convened session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. Executing a new MOU via a distinct parallel track (Islamabad/Pakistan) without a formal act directed at the suspended Oman channel = does NOT satisfy pathway 2.

forecasts.question: Will a publicly confirmed direct Israel-Iran military exchange (strikes both ways) occur in any 48h window between 2026-06-10 and EOD 2026-06-24?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVED-NO: The June 7-8 bidirectional exchange (Iran 7-barrage ballistic missile strike; Israel counter-strikes Isfahan/Kermanshah/Karaj/Tabriz/Mehrabad; ~12-14h elapsed; confirmed NPR/Al Jazeera/CNN/IDF/IRGC) predates F3's June 10 window start. Within June 10-24: Israel struck Iranian military targets June 13; Iran's planned retaliation halted by US diplomatic intervention June 14; no Iranian strike on Israeli territory within 48h of June 13 strikes. Ambiguity rule: unilateral strikes within 48h window = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. Note: DA (Källa B) assessed LIKELY-YES but committed a window-boundary error — the June 7-8 exchange is real and well-sourced but predates F3's measurement window.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a TIER1 source reports a publicly confirmed direct Israel-Iran military exchange — Israeli strikes on Iranian targets AND Iranian strikes on Israeli/Israeli-claimed targets — within any rolling 48h window between 2026-06-10 and 2026-06-24.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Two independent TIER1 (Reuters/AP/AFP/CNN/Al Jazeera) OR one TIER1 + official Israeli (IDF) or Iranian (IRGC) statement.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Proxy-only attacks without direct Iran-Israel state strikes do NOT count; one-directional strikes within the 48h window = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

forecasts.question: Will the Knesset pass the dissolution bill's final reading with a fixed election date earlier than 2026-10-27 before EOD 2026-07-15?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVED-NO: Knesset third-reading dissolution vote passed 62-0 on 2026-07-17 — two days after the EOD 2026-07-15 horizon. The vote confirmed elections on 2026-10-27, which equals but does not precede the threshold. Both YES criteria failed independently: (1) third reading occurred after the horizon; (2) fixed election date (Oct 27) is not earlier than Oct 27.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if the Knesset passes the dissolution bill in final (third) reading AND that passage specifies a fixed election date earlier than 2026-10-27, before EOD 2026-07-15.

forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Preliminary/first/second readings without final passage do NOT count; passage that leaves the date to a later committee or sets only a band without a fixed date = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO; if a fixed date on/after 27 Oct is set, resolve NO.

forecasts.question: Will Netanyahu's coalition lose its Knesset majority or dissolve early before 2026-10-27?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVED-NO (Judge override from RETIRE-OBE): Knesset voted 62-0 for dissolution 2026-07-17, with all votes cast by coalition members. Coalition maintained 62 seats through entire 25th Knesset life; no sub-61 roll-call vote confirmed in public record. Election confirmed at Oct 27 (equals horizon date; not earlier than horizon). Neither YES criterion met. Judge overrides Källa A's RETIRE-OBE: both YES pathways yielded definitive NO answers; OBE applies when a question is unanswerable, not when it answers NO. DA recommendation for AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO also rejected: outcome is clearly NO on both criteria.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a Knesset roll-call vote confirms coalition loss of majority (61 seats), OR if Netanyahu announces early dissolution and election date moves earlier than 2026-10-27. NO if coalition survives to mandatory election date with 61+ seats intact.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Knesset official record + Reuters/Haaretz/Times of Israel. Polling alone does not resolve.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: If coalition drops below 61 but Netanyahu remains caretaker PM until election: YES. If a single party departs but coalition retains 61+: NO. Reviewed weekly only (Sundays); no intra-week deltas.
